title: GGUF File Format Management
summary: This module provides core functionalities for managing GGUF (GGML Universal Format) files, including reading and writing metadata, defining and manipulating tensor information, and persisting the data to disk.

nodes.label: Copy Key-Value Metadata
nodes.title: Copy Key-Value Metadata
nodes.description: Iterates through key-value pairs from a source GGUF context and sets them in a target context, handling various scalar and array types.

nodes.label: Retrieve Scalar Key-Value
nodes.title: Retrieve Scalar Key-Value
nodes.description: Provides functions to retrieve single scalar values (uint8, int8, uint16, int16, uint32, int32, float32, uint64, int64, float64, bool) by key ID from the GGUF context.

nodes.label: Calculate Metadata Size
nodes.title: Calculate Metadata Size
nodes.description: Determines the total byte size required to serialize the metadata section of a GGUF context.

nodes.label: Extract Metadata Bytes
nodes.title: Extract Metadata Bytes
nodes.description: Serializes and retrieves the raw byte data representing the metadata section of a GGUF context.

nodes.label: Save GGUF to File
nodes.title: Save GGUF to File
nodes.description: Writes the entire GGUF context, including metadata and optionally tensor data, to a specified file path.

nodes.label: Define New Tensor
nodes.title: Define New Tensor
nodes.description: Adds the structural metadata (name, dimensions, offset) for a new tensor to the GGUF context, ensuring unique names.

nodes.label: Update Tensor Data Type
nodes.title: Update Tensor Data Type
nodes.description: Modifies the data type of an existing tensor, recalculating byte offsets for subsequent tensors to maintain file integrity.

nodes.label: Link Tensor Raw Data
nodes.title: Link Tensor Raw Data
nodes.description: Assigns a pointer to the raw data buffer for a previously defined tensor within the GGUF context, preparing it for serialization.

nodes.label: Serialize to Buffer
nodes.title: GGUF Buffer Serialization
nodes.description: An internal utility function used to serialize GGUF context data (or just metadata) into a byte buffer for size calculation or data extraction.

nodes.label: GGUF File Writer
nodes.title: GGUF File Stream Writer
nodes.description: An internal helper class that provides an interface for writing GGUF data to a file stream, abstracting file I/O details.

nodes.label: GGUF Serialization Core
nodes.title: GGUF Data Serialization Logic
nodes.description: The central logic responsible for serializing the GGUF context's metadata and tensor information to a given writer interface, used for file or buffer output.

groups.label: Metadata Read Operations
groups.title: Metadata Read Operations
groups.description: Functions for retrieving metadata values and properties from a GGUF context.

groups.label: Metadata Write Operations
groups.title: Metadata Write Operations
groups.description: Functionality for copying and setting key-value metadata within GGUF contexts.

groups.label: Tensor Management
groups.title: Tensor Definition and Data Management
groups.description: Components responsible for defining tensor structures, updating their types, and linking them to actual data buffers.

groups.label: File Persistence
groups.title: GGUF File Persistence
groups.description: Handles the serialization and writing of the complete GGUF context to a file on disk.
